Name: criterion
Definition: A single principle, standard, or rule used to make a judgment or decision.

Name: order
Definition: An order relation that formalizes the notion of sorting elements.

Name: condition
Definition: a contextual circumstance or environmental feature that limits or qualifies the constrained component

Name: state
Definition: indicates the physical, chemical or qualitative condition, including phases, of the constrained component

Name: purity
Definition: specifies the degree of quality or purity of a substance or generally of the component

Name: rating
Definition: an evaluation, assessment, or classification of something against a standardized scale or set of criteria.

Name: physical form
Definition: refers to the visible, structural, or material state of an object or substance, describing its physical appearance, state of matter, or spatial shape

Name: education
Definition: the systematic process of facilitating learning, acquiring knowledge, skills, values, beliefs, and habits through instruction, training, research, or discussion.

Name: locomotion state
Definition: refers to the distinct physiological, kinematic, or mechanical mode of self-propelled movement exhibited by an organism

Name: relationship
Definition: a significant connection, association, or involvement between two or more people, groups, or entities, characterized by mutual interaction, influence, or relevance.

Name: agent
Definition: an entity—either human, artificial, biological, or organizational—that senses its environment and acts upon it autonomously to achieve a specific goal or purpose.

Name: cause
Definition: indicates the cause that explains why the constrained component occurs or holds

Name: source
Definition: specifies the source, provenance, or starting point of the constrained component

Name: material type
Definition: provides a material type information about the constrained component

Name: role
Definition: indicates the role a person might have in the context of the variable

Name: classification
Definition: systematic arrangement in groups or categories according to established criteria

Name: location
Definition: provides a location-specific information about the constrained component

Name: reference
Definition: provides a reference point or information for the constrained component

Name: layer
Definition: constraints the component specifying in which layer the variable is measured

Name: spatial extent
Definition: indicates the spatial coverage within which the constrained component applies

Name: spatial distribution
Definition: defines the domain or criteria over which a statistical measure is calculated

Name: part
Definition: specifies a structural, anatomical, or biological sub-component (e.g., leaf, liver, root, surface layer) of an entity.

Name: direction
Definition: specifies the spatial orientation, vector heading, or flow orientation (e.g., downward, northward, incoming, outward) of the observed phenomenon relative to a spatial coordinate system, physical boundary, or reference feature.

Name: region
Definition: specifies an area of land or space that shares unifying characteristics, setting it apart from surrounding areas

Name: vicinity
Definition: the surrounding area, neighborhood, or general proximity near a specific place or landmark.

Name: sampling frequency
Definition: provides the sampling frequency that applies for the constrained component

Name: temporal extent
Definition: indicates the temporal coverage within which the constrained component applies

Name: time
Definition: provides time-specific information about the constrained component

Name: reporting frequency
Definition: defines how often a final data point is reported

Name: process
Definition: refers to a process that occurs when measuring the property

Name: event
Definition: identifies a specific occurrence, process, or life-stage event (e.g., birth, flooding, surgical procedure) that bounds or triggers the observation, serving as a contextual anchor when explicit calendar time or duration is unknown or non-applicable.

Name: age
Definition: restricts the human subject or population to a defined age interval, specific age value, or life stage.

Name: process
Definition: a series of systematic, ordered actions or steps taken to achieve a specific end or result.

Name: temporal reference
Definition: a linguistic mechanism, point of origin, or benchmark used to locate events, actions, or states in time relative to another point in time.

Name: quantity
Definition: specifies the quantity in which the entity occurs

Name: range
Definition: provides the range of allowed values

Name: threshold
Definition: defines the value limit that triggers a quality flag, indicating whether the measurement satisfies the threshold criterion.

Name: normalization
Definition: specifies the reference quantity to which a measurement is rescaled.

Name: wavelength
Definition: the distance in the line of advance of a wave from any one point to the next point of corresponding phase

Name: temperature
Definition: the average kinetic energy of the particles in a substance, determining how hot or cold it is.

Name: diameter
Definition: the length of a straight line through the center of an object or space

Name: resistivity
Definition: an intrinsic physical property of a material that measures how strongly it opposes or resists the flow of electric current.
